angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 845,144 km at 44.91 pc = 0.25 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 22.2688 +/- 0.0304 mas (same row, RUWE 1.05): 44.91 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.215 (1.190 to 1.239) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 845,144 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.070 (1.030 to 1.110) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5986 +/- 1 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 6586580842340695040: teff_gspphot 5985.9814 K (16th-84th percentiles 5984.9956-5987.033), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 6586580842340695040: teff_gspphot 5985.9814 K (16th-84th percentiles 5984.9956-5987.033), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/itonda.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.298, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 208487 (pscomppars): spectral type G2 V, from Rubenstein et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A.139R/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 208487: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 208487 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.09 dex, from Rubenstein et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A.139R/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 208487 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.233, from Rubenstein et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A.139R/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 208487 (pscomppars): age 1.95 Gyr, from Rubenstein et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A.139R/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 208487 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 5.58 km/s, from Rubenstein et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A.139R/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
